narrative.overview: A personal lawyer, not a firm. Seriousness from deep navy and a document-like serif, warmth from sparing brass, care from clean white paper and generous space. The hand-made details carry the identity: the notary seal, ruled legal-pad hairlines, court-file folders, a signature that draws itself.
keyCharacteristics: Inset rounded section cards on a stone page, alternating navy and paper grounds.
Frank Ruhl Libre headlines at display scale, Assistant for everything you read or tap.
Gold as an accent and as the primary button on dark grounds, never as text on light.
Scroll-told motion with one signature moment per section, always with a still fallback.

rules.name: The Brass Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: brass never colours text on a light ground; use brass-deep.

rules.name: The Tokens Only Rule
rules.body: Components never hold a raw hex; every colour is a CSS variable on :root.

rules.name: The Isolated Number Rule
rules.body: Numbers inside Hebrew text sit in an isolated LTR run with tabular figures.

dos: Do put WhatsApp first and the phone second in every contact pair.
Do give every motion a still fallback.
Do keep copy in /content, and read it in client code from @content/data.
Do use [placeholder: ...] for anything the client has not confirmed.
donts: Don't use stock courthouse imagery, scales of justice or a templated corporate grid.
Don't use emoji or em-dashes in site copy.
Don't set brass text on light grounds, or a raw hex inside a component.
Don't promise outcomes, show ratings, or invent stats or testimonials.
